translated: I actually listen to things like the radio or livestreams quite often when I'm going to sleep.
I see, so you listen to people talking.
There are times when it helps me sleep peacefully, but that's not really for when I'm working.
When I'm working, I might put on something like those "work BGM" videos on YouTube.
Do you play anything when you're reading a book?
Oh, I don't play anything when I'm reading.
The sound just gets in the way.
Is it silent when you're checking your work too?
When I'm checking, it's either silence or that work BGM, but I don't play it very loud.
Just enough so I can barely hear it.
But I think I generally prefer silence.
I think I prefer silence when I'm trying to focus on a story.
What about when you're reading manga?
I usually end up playing some kind of music.
